what: Free local retouch of v5 (no model call): v3 painted only two skis but the look line of S09.ambient 1 says there are three. A third ski was composited behind ski 2: ski 2's traced outline (game px, left edge x 523->505, right edge x 546->530, tip apex 523,153, foot y 800) shifted by +24 px / -12 px (it stands further back, so its foot is higher), its pixels tinted x(0.90, 0.84, 0.80), shown only outside ski 2 (dilated 1 px) and behind the dark pixels of the ski pole's grip, strap and shaft, plus a soft 20 % shadow on the wall offset +9/+4 px and blurred 8 master px. All other pixels are identical to v5.
